title: Vulkan Capability Float16 Validation Error
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 - Vulkan 1.3.260 (Forward+) - dedicated Radeon RX 590 Series

### Issue description

```
ERROR: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 0
vkCreateShaderModule(): SPIR-V Capability Float16 was declared, but one of the following requirements is required (VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features::shaderFloat16 OR VK_AMD_gpu_shader_half_float).
The Vulkan spec states: If pCode is a pointer to SPIR-V code, and pCode declares any of the capabilities listed in the SPIR-V Environment appendix, one of the corresponding requirements must be satisfied (https://vulkan.lunarg.com/doc/view/1.4.321.1/windows/antora/spec/latest/chapters/shaders.html#VUID-VkShaderModuleCreateInfo-pCode-08740)
   at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:665)
```

Possibly similar to
- #58167
- #58186

<details>
<summary>Full Log</summary>

Note: the other error here is already open at:
- #102358
